I have, over the last week seen the NHS at it's very best.
I had an eye test recently and was diagnosed with early signs of glaucoma.
I also suffer with severe pain through having arthritis and have had one knee replaced.
I asked for an appointment and saw a doctor within 3 hours.
I  raised the question of the effects of glaucoma and was immediately reassured.
Regarding my arthritis, I was invited to have a steroid injection into my knee and received the injection the next day. The relief was almost instantaneous.
I cannot give thanks enough to everyone involved at both the opticians and the medical practice at Polesworth and Dordon;- From the receptionists, the doctor (Dr Gordon Brown), and the lady who came from Nuneaton to take a blood sample. All were kind, helpful and obviously caring. THANK YOU.
